title: Retreated
description: Makes Blocks You Need's Treated Wood look like Immersive Engineering's.
body:
It just recolors the Blocks You Need blocks to be more in line with the IE Treated Wood stuff. It's not perfect, ping me in I guess the Create discord if you want to touch it up.

[https://i.imgur.com/TYQEBNu.png](https://i.imgur.com/TYQEBNu.png)![it's the textures in the resource pack, IE-BYN-IE-BYN etcetera. brown planks in various orientations.](https://i.imgur.com/TYQEBNu.png)
